verdict.rationale: Llama publishes a clear per-family license (Llama Community License) with model cards and USE_POLICY files, and provides multiple concrete download paths (official CLI 'llama-model download', signed-URL email flow, or Hugging Face org after accepting terms) plus verification tooling and run-anywhere guides (llama.cpp, ExecuTorch, desktop/mobile). Community debate exists over whether the license counts as 'open source' (llama-comm-5, llama-comm-12) but this is a terminology dispute, not evidence the weights are undownloadable or the license undisclosed. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a full download completing successfully, and clearer documentation of the >700M MAU licensing restriction mentioned only in community commentary.
